purpose: Extend current Q2 evidence through Confirmation Pilot #20 without modifying the immutable Pilots #1-#18 corpus, the Pilot #19 requalification record, or the Pilot #20 stop-loss record. The replay binds the Pilot #20 generic complete-diagnostic and candidate-recovery failure class to current provider-free production boundaries.

syntheticReplay.reason: The durable historical record proves the exact failure sequence, provenance and generic classification but the raw failed provider candidate is not promoted into a new exact-output fixture. The replay therefore reconstructs the smallest generic failure shape and binds it to current production recovery behavior.

completeDiagnosticBoundary.expectedDisposition: both independent defects returned in one complete diagnostic set

candidateRecoveryBoundary.expectedDisposition: rejected candidate 1 carries no accepted output; candidate 2 may fill the same required slot and the production route continues to expert_review_ready

exhaustionBoundary.expectedDisposition: two rejected candidates exhaust the bounded slot, no candidate 3 exists, and the course blocks rather than silently omitting the required Assessment slot

limitations: This is a synthetic generic replay of the Pilot #20 failure class, not a claim that the raw historical failed model output is being replayed byte-for-byte.
Q2 evidence does not by itself prove Q3 or Q6 recovery breadth/stability and does not authorize Q7 live-provider work.
Educational correctness and qualified human benchmark review remain separate assurance requirements.
content-factory/reliability-qualification.json remains paused and is deliberately not transitioned by this evidence slice.
